anti_collapse.decisive_reason: After source framing is removed, the list-compare-weaken action, agree/conflict observables, retain-supported-candidates warrant, change/load decomposition, and replay/rollback next step are operationally identical to the baseline reliability-engineer competing-cause comparison; substitution loses nothing.

action.rationale: List competing explanations and weaken those contradicted by traces/counters/replay is the baseline ordinary method of comparing competing causes, bisecting revisions, and testing in staging.

inferential_warrant.rationale: Retain supported contributions with unresolved alternatives and that temporal association alone is not causation directly restates baseline inference pattern.

next_inquiry.rationale: Discriminating replay or rollback/reintroduction then checking reproduction under comparable conditions matches ordinary next actions verbatim.

observable.rationale: Agreement or conflict of each candidate with latency, workload and replay behavior uses only ordinary evidence: traces, latency distributions, counters, and replay/rollback observations.

problem_decomposition.rationale: Decomposition into deployed changes, load and configuration is the baseline ordinary candidate-cause set with no new partition or constraint.

formalization.rationale: Listing, comparing and weakening only makes explicit the native compare-and-disconfirm logic; no new stopping condition, evidence-selection rule, falsification condition, or next-step constraint with operational consequence is added.

materiality.rationale: No change in how inquiry proceeds; steps, evidence, and logic are same epistemic logic as baseline with only wording-level explicitness.

native_reduction.closest_native_equivalent: Compare competing causes (deployed changes, load, configuration) using traces, load/configuration stratification and disconfirming staging replay and rollback/reintroduction tests
native_reduction.rationale: Closest ordinary equivalent performs same operations on same evidence to same warrant; replacement loses no observable, inference, decomposition, or follow-on inquiry.
